Mission Local reported that Dolores Park allows reservations of parts of the park for a fee. In the 2016 story, the reported fee ranged from $33 for groups under 50 to $325 for groups larger than 400, plus a $200 security deposit and an application. The story describes reserving specific areas—not a general charge for simply using the park.
